[SWS_DM_01077] Clearing individual configured DDIDs
⌈
On reception of
service ’DynamicallyDefineDataIdentifier’ with subfunction 0x03 clearDynamicallyDe-
finedDataIdentifier and one ore more dynamicallyDefinedDataIdentifier in the request,
the DM shall clear all the DDIDs from the request.
⌋
